candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to always return false (remove check for IAccessControl), so queries for IAccessControl now return different result.
Change supportsInterface to check only super and omit IAccessControl comparison, so queries for IAccessControl may now return false when original returned true.
Invert original boolean expression to return true only when interfaceId is not IAccessControl and super supports it, altering result for IAccessControl queries.
